axes.contour: Whole two-wing butterfly and antennae remain intact; curved violet outline, no rectangular background. Fine detail is small at64px; mip sampling is visibly smoother than rejected attempt1.
axes.material: Painted wing gradients/dots read beside the textured parchment and shell; original font fish/bird and all six repeated specimen glyphs remain stylistically mismatched and open.
axes.palette: Coral/lavender/aqua wings share violet accents and warm gold neighbor frame; no source recolor.
axes.light: Retained baked artwork gradients; no new shader or relighting. It remains a UI symbol rather than a relit world object.
axes.perspective: Frontal category symbol consistent with the planar UI controls; no imposed world-depth claim.
axes.scale: 64px maximum native icon,36px style insets; full butterfly stays inside painted frame at both widths. Count readable from0/6through6/6; machine actual-font/allstates checks supplement direct0/2/6views. Recognition on targetphone remains pending.
axes.contact: UI icon intentionally floats on tab parchment; no physical support/contact scene is being claimed.
axes.occlusion: Wing outline and counter stay clear of border and selected crest in inspected selected/held/focus/hover/restored captures. Disabled native tint remains bounded to disabledcontrol.
axes.readability: A category butterfly is visible without reading. It does not distinguish six species and is not child recognition evidence.
axes.action_state: Original tab selects insects on release, held state retains prior page until release; focus/pressed/hover/disabled/restored responses inspected. Back and reentry preserve original state/callback behavior by native checks.
